name: dev-orchestra
description: Plan with a strong model, build with a cheap swarm: an MCP server that runs slices of a feature through a gate and a local commit.

scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "fs.rmSync('.teste',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node dist/index.js --selftest && node --test --test-concurrency=1 ".teste/*.test.js" && npm --prefix web test
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run desktop:build && electron dist-desktop/main.js
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml
